POST /v1/realtime/ticket.summary: Get a one-time ticket for the realtime socket
POST /v1/realtime/ticket.description: Browsers cannot send an Authorization header on a WebSocket, so a signed-in client asks for a ticket first and connects with it. A ticket works once and lasts 30 seconds.
POST /v1/realtime/ticket.access: any signed-in member of the organization (token issued with `org`)

GET /v1/realtime.description: Upgrade to a WebSocket with `?ticket=` from POST /v1/realtime/ticket. You receive JSON events `{id, type, channel, org, actor, ts, data}` for the organization (`presence`, `person.updated`, `person.status`, `rights.changed`, `approval.changed`, `ticket.updated`) and for your own account (`notification`, `conversation.new`, `conversation.removed`, `call.incoming`, `call.started`, `call.answered`, `call.declined`, `call.ended`, `session.ended`, `session.replaced`). To get a conversation's events send `{"op":"sub","conv":"<uuid>"}` (you must be a member; up to 500 at a time) and receive `message.new`, `message.deleted`, `member.added`, `member.joined`, `member.removed`, `keys.updated`, `keys.rotated`, `record.saved`, `record.deleted`, `file.added`, `comm.published`, `project.updated`, `ticket.updated` and `typing`. Other frames you may send: `{"op":"unsub","conv":...}`, `{"op":"typing","conv":...}` and `{"op":"ping"}` every 30 seconds (answered with `{"type":"pong"}`). Message bodies in events are sealed envelopes.
GET /v1/realtime.access: a ticket from POST /v1/realtime/ticket (no Authorization header)

errors.401: The ticket is missing, already used, expired, or the session was ended
